text: Which platform was GSE309890 run on, and what organism is it?

## Abstract
The GEO Series dataset GSE309890 was investigated to determine the organism studied and the sequencing platform used. Using the GEO API, the metadata of GSE309890 was retrieved. The study involved Escherichia coli strain K-12 substrain MG1655 and utilized the platform GPL24659. This information is important for researchers referencing this dataset for gene expression profiling and for understanding the experimental context of the data.

## I. Introduction
Background: The dataset GSE309890 is an expression profiling study by high throughput sequencing. Knowing the organism and platform is essential for data interpretation and reproducibility.

Literature Review: No specific literature was retrieved referencing GSE309890 within this search.

Knowledge Gap: Users often lack immediate access to detailed dataset metadata such as organism and platform.

Objective: To identify the organism and sequencing platform for the GEO Series GSE309890.

## II. Materials and Methods
Study Design: Metadata search of GEO Series accession GSE309890.

Materials: GEO database accessed through the GEO series tool.

Procedures: Query with accession "GSE309890" requesting metadata.

Statistical Analysis: Not applicable; retrieval of descriptive metadata.

## III. Results
| Attribute  | Value                                |
|------------|------------------------------------|
| Organism   | Escherichia coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655 |
| Platform   | GPL24659                           |

## IV. Discussion
Interpretation: The dataset GSE309890 was conducted on E. coli K-12 MG1655 organism using the GPL24659 platform.

Context: This platform and organism specify the technical and biological background of the study titled about sertraline induced resistance mechanisms.

Limitations: The platform ID is provided; further details require platform metadata lookup. The organism name is the taxon used for sample origin.

Conclusion: The organism and platform for GSE309890 are E. coli K-12 MG1655 and GPL24659 respectively, important for data reuse and analysis.

## References
[1] GEO Series GSE309890 metadata: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE309890

Data provided by NCBI GEO database.
